title: Hardening subscription billing + drop shipment scenarios
summary: Subscription billing now handles drop shipment scenarios and blank default quantity settings correctly by using serial quantity values and subscribing to drop shipment purchase order events.
key_points: Falls back to serial quantity instead of relying on 'Qty. to ship' field when it is zero
Fixes issue where blank 'Default Quantity to Ship' setting caused subscription creation to fail
Adds subscription handling for sales orders closed by drop shipment purchase order receipts
Fake invoicing now correctly applied to sales orders released through drop shipment path
Tests added to verify both scenarios
